audited_source_corrections.action: Seeded the beth iteration at beth indexed by the successor of card(A), ensuring that the resulting fixed point is strictly larger than card(A).
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source starts at card(A) and applies beth iteration, then calls card(A) strictly less than its limit. If card(A) is already a beth fixed point, all iterates remain card(A), so the strict inequality fails and W need not be injective.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தொடக்க மதிப்பாக A இன் கண அளவெண்ணின் வரிசையெண் தொடர்ச்சியில் உள்ள பெத் மதிப்பை எடுத்து, அதன் பின்னரான மீள்வரையறையை அப்படியே வைத்திருக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Keeping the stationary fixed-point counterexample; adding an unexplained strictness premise to A; starting with a non-cardinal ordinal successor.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The beth function is increasing, with beth at the successor index strictly above card(A). The subsequent omega iteration reaches a beth fixed point, including when the seed itself is already fixed, and remains above card(A).
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the revised seed make card(A) strictly smaller than tau(A) even when card(A) was originally a beth fixed point?
